title: 5.0L Ignition: System and Component References
introduction:
This reference covers Engine Ignition - 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT. I check the engine identity before choosing the ignition reading—a familiar-looking engine cover makes a lousy filing system.

The Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual supplies both the operating explanation and the component descriptions at the location below. This page is a guide to that reference; it contains no ignition operating details, component descriptions, diagnostic tests or repair steps.

edits.text: To learn how the ignition system operates, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual. See Section 1 Description and Operation.
edits.why: Start with the system explanation to give the individual component descriptions a working context.
